applicabilityBasis.summary: GBPm is marketed for currency payments, remittances or trade and targets GBP value. GBPm is issued against locked USDm through Mento CDP branches; redemption is into protocol collateral and subject to documented market-hour restrictions. The reviewed disclosures do not identify a person legally obligated to convert, redeem or repurchase holders' tokens for a fixed amount of national-currency or deposit monetary value. GENIUS section 2(22) excludes fixed-value digital assets from that redemption limb, so USDm swaps/collateral redemption plus payment marketing do not establish the full definition. Applicability remains unclear rather than conclusively exempt or apparently qualifying.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. GBPm is minted by borrowers against USDm collateral. The published CDP documentation describes collateral redemption and FX market-hour restrictions. The reviewed materials do not establish a named legal issuer obligated to redeem at par in the referenced national currency or a national-currency bank deposit. redemptionPolicyPresent is false for such an issuer 1:1 monetary-value policy; public protocol USDm swap or collateral-redemption mechanics are documented. The live Mento Reserve dashboard is self-published reserve and CDP collateral disclosure. No independent monthly reserve attestation was located. Mento Labs GmbH is identified as a technical and reserve-operations provider, and the Cayman Mento Protocol Foundation privacy notice identifies a data controller; neither role alone establishes token issuance or a holder redemption obligation. MGP-19 is a governance proposal, not verified evidence of completed control transfers. The expected GENIUS effective date is January 18, 2027; foreign-issuer lawful-order conditions and the July 18, 2028 general DASP licensed-issuer rule have distinct clocks. No token-specific authorization, registered foreign exception or enforcement source was found in the bounded public review. Applicability and foreign-exception posture remain unresolved. issuerEntity is Mento Protocol as a factual protocol-family descriptor for the documented GBPm issuance system and Safety Score issuer attribution. It does not identify a legal entity or establish the statutory issuer or a holder-facing monetary redemption obligation. Mento Labs GmbH is not established by these disclosures as GBPm's legal issuer. The descriptor preserves the Mento-family issuer key mento.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the independently reopened regulator proposals, NYDFS entity directory and greenlist, Mento product/governance disclosures and recorded searches did not identify GBPm or an established legal issuer of GBPm as a GENIUS permitted issuer, state-qualified issuer, official pending applicant or registered foreign issuer. The materials do not establish a GENIUS-specific issuer intent statement or token-specific enforcement action. The statutory legal issuer remains unresolved. This is a bounded public-source finding; it does not prove absence of confidential filings or exhaustive review of all state registers.
